turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I understand. I can send a technician on Thursday between nine and twelve. Or, because you need it for your classes, we can send you a new router tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Is the new router easy to set up? I'd like to fix this as soon as possible.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Then please send the new router tomorrow. And if it still doesn't work, can the technician come on Thursday?

turns.speaker: Partner
